desc: Defias Mask: a red Defias bandana tied over the nose and mouth, a dark hood above it. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
Defias Leathers: a dark brown leather vest over a red shirt, red sash at the waist, a coil of rope on one shoulder. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Venture Hard Hat: a yellow goblin miner's hard hat with a lamp on the front. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
Venture Overalls: dirty yellow-and-black striped overalls with a Venture Co. patch, a tool belt full of wrenches. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Kolkar Headdress: a Kolkar centaur headdress of feathers and beads with a bone at the front. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
Kolkar Hides: rough tanned hides tied with leather cords, a bone-and-bead necklace, war paint stripes on the hide. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Burning Blade Hood: a dark red cultist hood with ORANGE flames flickering along its edge. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Burning Blade Robes: dark red and black robes with an ORANGE flaming sword sigil (the clan's own mark; orange is its colour), glowing fel runes along the hem. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Syndicate Hood: a black hood pulled low with an ORANGE Syndicate mask (cloth) over the nose and mouth. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Syndicate Garb: dark grey leather armour with an ORANGE Syndicate sash (orange, the old kingdom of Alterac's colour, the colour of their masks), lots of little pouches and hidden daggers. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Scarlet Cap: a red Scarlet Crusade cap with a white trim and the Scarlet Crusade's own emblem: a stylised white-and-gold flame. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Scarlet Tabard: a red and white Scarlet Crusade tabard with the Scarlet Crusade's own emblem: a stylised white-and-gold flame over chainmail. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Crimson Legion Cap: the Scarlet Crusade cap INVERTED, as worn by the Crimson Legion of Stratholme: WHITE with a red trim and the Scarlet Crusade's stylised flame emblem in RED. Only the Scarlet Crusade's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible

Crimson Legion Tabard: the Scarlet Crusade tabard INVERTED, as worn by the Crimson Legion of Stratholme: a WHITE tabard with red trim and alternating white and red panels, the Scarlet Crusade's stylised flame emblem in RED in the middle, over chainmail. Only the Scarlet Crusade's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Bloodsail Bicorne: a black pirate bicorne hat with a red Bloodsail feather and a skull badge. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
Bloodsail Coat: a red and white striped pirate shirt under an open black coat with brass buttons, a red bandolier. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dark Iron Helm: a sooty dark iron helm with a flared rim and glowing orange rivets. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dark Iron Apron: a heavy dark iron smith's apron over sooty chainmail, glowing orange cracks like molten metal, a FLAMING ANVIL emblem on the apron (the Dark Iron mark). Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Blackrock Helm: a spiked helm of dark BLACK iron (not bronze or copper) as worn by the Blackrock orcs of Blackrock Spire, with jagged red war-paint stripes. NO Horde symbol or crest anywhere (the Blackrock clan are not the Horde). It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible

Blackrock Plate: heavy spiked orcish plate armour of dark BLACK iron (not bronze or copper) as worn by the Blackrock orcs of Blackrock Spire, red cloth hanging from the belt and jagged red war-paint stripes on the plates. NO Horde symbol or crest anywhere (the Blackrock clan are not the Horde)

Cultist Hood: a deep purple Cult of the Damned hood with a skull clasp. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
Cultist Robes: tattered purple and black Cult of the Damned robes with a bone-white skull emblem on the chest. Only this faction's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
Trophy Skull: a big horned monster skull on a stick, held up proudly like a trophy
Spyglass: a long brass spyglass, held up as if spotting something rare
Stolen Crown: a big jewelled golden crown, held up in the fist like a stolen prize
Dungeon Torch: a burning wooden torch with a bright flame, held up to light the way
Dented Shield: a round wooden shield with an iron rim, battered and dented from many fights
Explorer's Map: a big old rolled-out treasure map with a red X and a compass rose

Nesingwary's Pith Helmet: Hemet Nesingwary's famous big-game hunting hat from World of Warcraft: a beige safari pith helmet with a brown leather band. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible

Nesingwary's Safari Gear: Hemet Nesingwary's big-game hunting outfit from World of Warcraft: a khaki safari jacket with rolled sleeves and many pockets over a white shirt, a leather bandolier of rifle cartridges across the chest and a rifle strap over one shoulder

Nathanos's Hood: Nathanos Blightcaller's ranger hood from World of Warcraft: a tattered deep grey-green hood with a ragged torn edge, worn up over the head with the face fully visible, a pale bone-white trim and a small dark iron clasp at the throat in the Forsaken style

Ranger Lord's Mail: Nathanos Blightcaller's ranger armour from World of Warcraft: a mix of grey-green mail and dark leather, one clean POLISHED steel breastplate over the chest, a single spiked dark shoulder guard, a tattered grey-green cloak hanging from the shoulders, leather bracers and a quiver of black-fletched arrows peeking over one shoulder - grim, Forsaken colours, matching his hood

Rexxar's Mask: the Mok'Nathal beastmaster Rexxar's famous mask from World of Warcraft, like a bat cowl: a dark iron-and-leather mask over the forehead, brow, round the eyes and the bridge of the nose, with two TALL POINTED ear-like spikes rising from the top of the head and open eye holes, rivets along its edges, and a long wild black mane of hair spilling out behind it

Rexxar's Beastmaster Armour: Rexxar's armour from World of Warcraft: HUGE rounded dark iron pauldrons with jagged spikes and thick dark fur under them, a bare chest crossed by broad brown leather straps, heavy iron-banded leather bracers, a wide studded belt and a ragged leather kilt, two great axe hafts hanging at the hips - rugged, dark iron and brown leather, matching his mask

Mo'grosh Skull Cap: a cap of a dwarf's dented iron helmet worn as a trophy, too small, with a gray wolf tail hanging off the back. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Mo'grosh Furs: patched gray wolf furs over one shoulder, a belt of stolen Ironforge mining tools and a rope of dwarven beard braids. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Splinter Fist Brand Helm: a rough wooden-and-iron helm, splintered planks bound with nails, a little torch flame burning on top. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Splinter Fist Slaver Gear: a leather harness with iron shackles and broken chains hanging from it, a coiled whip at the belt, scorch marks on the leather. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Boulderfist War Paint Band: a thick leather headband with a round river boulder strapped on the front, bright YELLOW war paint stripes across it. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Boulderfist Hides: a heavy brown hide loincloth-tunic held by a belt of fist-sized stones, bold YELLOW war paint handprints all over the hide. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Crushridge Snow Helm: a dented iron helm with a fur rim against the mountain cold and two short ram horns. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Crushridge Plunder: thick white mountain furs over rusted mismatched plate pieces plundered from Alterac, a sack of loot tied at the hip. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dustbelcher Wyrm Skull: the skull of a young red whelp worn as a helmet, dusty and sun-bleached, little horns sticking out. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dustbelcher Wyrmhunter Gear: dusty tan leathers with dragon-scale patches sewn on, a harpoon rope coiled over the shoulder, desert dust everywhere. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Mosh'Ogg Witch Doctor Mask: a carved painted jungle-wood voodoo mask pushed up on the head like a hat, feathers and little bones dangling. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Mosh'Ogg Voodoo Wraps: green-and-purple jungle cloth wraps, a necklace of shrunken trinkets and teeth, little pouches of mojo at the belt. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Gordunni Blue Topknot Helm: a bronze cap with a tall blue-dyed topknot plume and BLUE war paint on the brim. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Gordunni Scroll Harness: a leather harness covered in stolen glowing blue night elf scrolls and runes, blue cloth sash, BLUE colours throughout. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dunemaul Desert Wrap: a sand-colored cloth head wrap like a desert nomad's turban, a strip of cloth hanging down the back. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dunemaul Desert Robes: loose sand-beige desert robes, a belt with a big waterskin and a curved desert club, sand pouring out of the folds. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dreadmaul Fel Spike Helm: a black iron helm with jagged spikes and a faint GREEN fel glow in the cracks. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Dreadmaul Warplate: scorched black iron plates strapped over red-brown hide, chains, a little green fel crystal shard on the chest. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Firegut Fire Pot Helm: a cast-iron cooking pot worn as a helmet with ORANGE flames and smoke coming out of the top. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Firegut Ember Belly: a soot-blackened leather apron with glowing ORANGE embers smouldering in it, a fire-bellows hanging at the side, scorch marks. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Gordok Tribute Crown: a lopsided gold crown far too small, the kind King Gordok hands out, stuck with gems that are plainly fake. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Gordok Royal Guard Plate: heavy dark iron plates with gold trim over black hide, a purple royal sash with a tribute coin purse. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Spirestone Battle Helm: a rough-hewn helm carved from dark volcanic Blackrock stone, glowing red cracks, one big horn. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Spirestone Battle Lord Plate: heavy black volcanic-stone and iron armor plates, red molten glow between the plates, chains over the shoulders. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Deadwind Ghost Hood: a tattered gray hood flapping in the wind, BLUE ghostly mist swirling around it. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Deadwind Storm Cloak: a long tattered gray-blue cloak whipped by the wind, crow feathers stuck in it, a cracked lantern on the belt. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere

Urok Doomhowl Hood: a big black worg's head worn as a hood, mouth open, teeth over the brow. It sits on the head, above the brow; the face is fully visible. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
Urok Doom Armor: black spiked iron armor with worg pelts over the shoulders, an iron collar with a broken chain. Only this tribe's own markings: NO Horde or Alliance symbol or crest anywhere
